neighbours.label: the first split piece of an uncommon surname just after a first name or title, in news and sport (Francois P|ienaar, Adam L|allana, Minister But|helezi), as opposed to the same sentences with no name
fire: The trophy went to captain Tiaan Oosthuizen after the final.
The defense was led by Sead Kolasinac and a former Gunner.
In a speech, Deputy Minister Kgalema Motlanthe defended it.
In midfield the coach chose Henrikh Mkhitaryan again.
Manager Ivan Rakitic said the team kept going.
Late in the game, Arturo Vidal scored from close range.
In the same year Nomvula Zwane joined the cabinet.
The award was given to Pieter Oosthuizen last week.
quiet: The trophy went to the captain of the team after the final.
The defense was led by two young players and a former Gunner.
In a speech, the deputy minister of finance defended it.
In midfield the coach chose the same players again.
The manager said the team kept going.
Late in the game, the visitors scored from close range.
In the same year a new member joined the cabinet.
The award was given to the school last week.

short: surname's first piece in news and sport
notes: Whole-token and readily split names behaved differently in probes ('Mashatile' 0.01, 'Carrick' 0.10, 'Pienaar' 1.16). Tokenization checked for the fire names, except Tiaan, Sead, Kgalema, Henrikh, Arturo and Nomvula.
